title: The Notebook My Mother Borrowed
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：situation　|　正文 373 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 situation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① situation in our family became clear to me one evening in March. My father's shop had lost half its customers to the new supermarket, and my form teacher had asked, politely, whether sixth form was really the sensible choice. My mother said nothing for a long time. Then she said: 'We cannot decide this by worrying about it.'

So she borrowed a notebook from somewhere and did something I had never seen an adult do. She wrote down every fact we actually had: fees, rent, the distance to the county town, the cost of one winter coat. '② The situation is that these are the only things we know,' she said. 'Everything else is weather.'

Then we took stock of the ③ situation: four choices, none of them attractive, two of them honest. In any situation, my father believed, the young should stay. My father wanted me to stay and mind the shop — he never said so, but everybody knew — and I wanted to leave, which I also never said. ④ In a difficult situation the people who write things down usually win, though not always kindly.

My aunt, who lives in the county town, arrived on the Sunday and ⑤ saved the situation in eleven minutes: she offered me a room, on condition that I cook twice a week. Our own street had lost its trade slowly; my father blamed the road and my mother blamed the prices, and neither of them mentioned the shop's ⑥ situation — a corner nobody turned down any more.

Financial ⑦ situations change faster than anybody admits, my father said afterwards, which I did not understand at the time. I left in September with one suitcase and the notebook. Looking back, deciding was never the hard part: anybody can decide. The hard part was preparing the ground honestly, weighing what we knew and accepting that this particular ⑧ situation would never become comfortable first. Nobody in our family had ever left before, so there was no model to follow, only a ⑨ situation nobody had rehearsed. Every situation, my mother said afterwards, has more facts in it than people bother to collect. Some decisions, I now think, ⑩ put you in a new situation long before they solve the old one.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 形势；局面（偏重整体态势）
C. n. 处境；境遇（经济、家庭方面的境况）
D. n. （房屋、店铺等的）位置；环境
E. 固定搭配：in a ... situation 处于……的境地
F. 固定搭配：the situation is that ... 情况是……
G. 固定搭配：save the situation 收拾残局；挽回局面
H. 固定搭配：take stock of the situation 估量形势；审视局面

items.q: The situation in our family became clear
The situation is that these are the only things we know
In a difficult situation the people who write things down
arrived on the Sunday and saved the situation
the shop's situation — a corner nobody turned down
accepting that this particular situation would never become comfortable
only a situation nobody had rehearsed
put you in a new situation

answers.why: the situation in our family 指家里的整体“情况”，包括收入下降与升学选择两件事。
The situation is that ... 是固定句式，意为“情况是……”，用来把已知事实摆出来。
take stock of the situation 意为“估量形势、清点情况”，后接四个选项的说明。
in a difficult situation 意为“处于困难的境地”，说明此时记录事实的人占上风。
save the situation 意为“挽回局面、解围”，姑姑十一分钟里用一个提议解决了僵局。
这里指店铺所处的“位置、环境”——一个没人再拐进去的街角。
financial situations 指经济方面的“处境、境况”，父亲感慨其变化之快。
这里的 situation 指整体的“形势、局面”，作者承认它不会先变得舒服起来。
a situation nobody had rehearsed 指一种从未被演练过的“情况”。
put sb in a new situation 与 in a ... situation 同属一组，意为“让人处于新的境地”。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我们家的情况在三月的那个晚上变得清楚了。（situation n.）
情况是：我们知道的只有这些。（the situation is that）
我们首先估量了一下形势。（take stock of the situation）
在困难的处境中，记录事实的人往往占上风。（in a difficult situation）
姑姑用一个提议挽回了局面。（save the situation）
每个决定都会把你放进一个新的境地。（put sb in a new situation）
answers: The situation in our family became clear one evening in March.
The situation is that these are the only things we know.
First we took stock of the situation.
In a difficult situation, the people who write things down usually win.
My aunt saved the situation with one offer.
Every decision puts you in a new situation.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 situation 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: The situation in our family was simple to state: half our customers were gone, and nobody wanted to say it aloud.
'The situation is that these are the only facts we have,' my mother said, writing the cost of everything down.
So we took stock of the situation, and found four choices, none attractive and only two honest.
In a difficult situation the person who writes things down usually weighs them better than the person who worries.
My aunt saved the situation with one offer, though financial situations change faster than anybody admits.
Leaving put me in a new situation I had not rehearsed, and that, I think, is what deciding really costs.
